# Anonymized DLL reference for TestConnectOptionsMatchDLL.
# Source: R6 live runs of txmlconnector64-6.47.2.26.4.dll under Wine 11.21 against the
# Finam demo server through a logging proxy, 2026-11-04 (raw data .re-run/r6, not in git).
# Frames were decrypted with tools/wire-decode -payload -1 and re-encoded as below.
# Format: 'key = value', '#' comments; run prefixes: default, options, lang_en.
#
# Excluded on purpose: password, real login (anonymized to TESTLOGIN), challenge/proof,
# session keys, UID/SID, client/union ids, RQ_LOGIN reply payload, RQ_PWD proof.
# The RQ_PWD tail is re-encoded from this DUMMY ClientInfo (content lengths preserved):
client.computer_name = "TESTHOSTXXXXXXX"
client.user_name = "TESTUSER"
client.os = "TESTOSXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
client.hardware_id = 0x0000100000000000
client.addresses = 0x00100000,0x10000000
client.trailer_ru = 0
client.trailer_en = 1
#
# RQ_LOGIN payload = session.LoginPayload("TESTLOGIN"). The captured login was 8 bytes in a
# 18-byte payload; Z12 is NUL-terminated and variable-length, so the anonymized payload is
# 19 bytes. Everything after the Z12 field is byte-exact.
rq_login = 78004e0001021c544553544c4f47494e00ffe8
rq_login_payload_len_captured = 18
#
# Frame lists are run-length compressed request/reply type sequences (NxM = type N repeated M
# times). RQ_MAIN (5) counts depend on poll timing; RQ_TIME (50) near the end belongs to the
# get_servtime_difference command in the same harness script, RQ_LOGOUT (2) to disconnect.
#
